coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night in Bedroom 1, air conditioner set to a cool comfortable temperature for the heatwave
Waking up, using the toilet and taking a cool morning shower to freshen up before work
Preparing and eating a quick breakfast with toast and coffee, and filling a water bottle for the hot day ahead
Getting dressed in light work clothes, checking the phone for messages, and packing a bag with uniform and lunch
Commuting to the hospital in the early heat, travelling by public transport to arrive before the outpatient clinic opens
Working as a hospital physiotherapist, running morning rehabilitation sessions, assessing patients and updating treatment notes
Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating a packed meal and resting in the staff room away from the heat
Continuing afternoon physiotherapy work, delivering exercise therapy, manual therapy and patient education sessions
Commuting home from the hospital during the hottest part of the day, staying hydrated on the way back
Preparing a simple dinner with the induction cooker and rice cooker, then eating at the kitchen table
Washing up the dishes and loading the dishwasher, wiping down the counters and putting food away in the refrigerator
Taking a cool evening shower and changing into light comfortable clothes for the night
Relaxing in front of the TV with the air conditioner on, watching a show and doing light stretching for the back and shoulders
Using the computer under the desk lamp to review patient notes, read physiotherapy articles and plan tomorrow's caseload
Winding down for bed, checking the phone briefly, setting the alarm and switching off the main light
Sleeping in Bedroom 1 with the air conditioner running to stay cool through the hot night
